# This code retrieves raw data collected during an in scanner Attention Network Task and extracts the exact times where specific stimuli 
# was presented. There are 7 total regressors. 
```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)


# INPUT / OUTPUT FOLDERS


input_dir <- "~/Desktop/research/Elton/ANT"
output_dir <- "~/Desktop/research/Elton/ANT_timing"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}


# FIND ALL LARA FILES


files <- list.files(
  path = input_dir,
  pattern = "^LARA[0-9]{3}.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)


# QC SUMMARY DATA FRAME


qc_summary <- data.frame(
  Participant = character(),
  Run = integer(),
  BlankCue = integer(),
  CenterCue = integer(),
  SpatialCue = integer(),
  CongruentCorrect = integer(),
  CongruentIncorrect = integer(),
  IncongruentCorrect = integer(),
  IncongruentIncorrect = integer(),
  TotalCorrect = integer(),
  Flag = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# PROCESS EACH PARTICIPANT


for (file in files) {

  cat("\n=========================================\n")
  cat("Processing:", basename(file), "\n")

  dat <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  participant <- regmatches(
    basename(file),
    regexpr("^LARA[0-9]{3}", basename(file))
  )


  # STANDARDIZE RESPONSE KEYS


  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      resp.keys = tolower(as.character(resp.keys)),
      corrAns = tolower(as.character(corrAns))
    )


  # SCORE CORRECT RESPONSES
  #
  # LEFT  = 1 or b
  # RIGHT = 2 or y
  #
  # Any other response (including None) = incorrect


  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      correct = case_when(
        corrAns == "left" &
          resp.keys %in% c("1", "b") ~ 1,

        corrAns == "right" &
          resp.keys %in% c("2", "y") ~ 1,

        TRUE ~ 0
      )
    )


  # PROCESS EACH RUN


  runs <- sort(unique(na.omit(dat$run)))

  for (run_number in runs) {

    run_dat <- dat %>%
      filter(run == run_number)


    # TIME ZERO


    time0 <- run_dat$MainInstruc.stopped[
      which(!is.na(run_dat$MainInstruc.stopped))[1]
    ]

    run_dat <- run_dat %>%
      mutate(
        cue_onset = cues.started - time0,
        target_onset = target.started - time0
      )


    # CUE REGRESSORS


    blank_cue <- run_dat %>%
      filter(cue == "stim/blank.png") %>%
      pull(cue_onset) %>%
      na.omit()

    center_cue <- run_dat %>%
      filter(cue == "stim/centre.png") %>%
      pull(cue_onset) %>%
      na.omit()

    spatial_cue <- run_dat %>%
      filter(cue %in% c(
        "stim/lower.png",
        "stim/upper.png"
      )) %>%
      pull(cue_onset) %>%
      na.omit()


    # TARGET REGRESSORS


    congruent_correct <- run_dat %>%
      filter(
        tar %in% c(
          "stim/congLeft.png",
          "stim/congRight.png"
        ),
        correct == 1
      ) %>%
      pull(target_onset) %>%
      na.omit()

    congruent_incorrect <- run_dat %>%
      filter(
        tar %in% c(
          "stim/congLeft.png",
          "stim/congRight.png"
        ),
        correct == 0
      ) %>%
      pull(target_onset) %>%
      na.omit()

    incongruent_correct <- run_dat %>%
      filter(
        tar %in% c(
          "stim/incongLeft.png",
          "stim/incongRight.png"
        ),
        correct == 1
      ) %>%
      pull(target_onset) %>%
      na.omit()

    incongruent_incorrect <- run_dat %>%
      filter(
        tar %in% c(
          "stim/incongLeft.png",
          "stim/incongRight.png"
        ),
        correct == 0
      ) %>%
      pull(target_onset) %>%
      na.omit()


    # QUALITY CONTROL


    total_correct <-
      length(congruent_correct) +
      length(incongruent_correct)

    flag <- ifelse(total_correct < 10, "YES", "NO")

    cat("\nParticipant:", participant,
        " Run:", run_number, "\n")

    cat("Blank cue:", length(blank_cue), "\n")
    cat("Center cue:", length(center_cue), "\n")
    cat("Spatial cue:", length(spatial_cue), "\n")
    cat("Congruent correct:", length(congruent_correct), "\n")
    cat("Congruent incorrect:", length(congruent_incorrect), "\n")
    cat("Incongruent correct:", length(incongruent_correct), "\n")
    cat("Incongruent incorrect:", length(incongruent_incorrect), "\n")
    cat("Total correct:", total_correct, "\n")

    if(flag=="YES"){
      warning(
        paste(
          participant,
          "Run",
          run_number,
          "may have reversed response mapping."
        )
      )
    }
    

    # CREATE SINGLE TIMING CSV


    max_length <- max(
      length(blank_cue),
      length(center_cue),
      length(spatial_cue),
      length(congruent_correct),
      length(congruent_incorrect),
      length(incongruent_correct),
      length(incongruent_incorrect)
    )

    pad <- function(x, n) {
      c(x, rep(NA, n - length(x)))
    }

    timing_df <- data.frame(
      blank_cue = pad(blank_cue, max_length),
      center_cue = pad(center_cue, max_length),
      spatial_cue = pad(spatial_cue, max_length),
      congruent_correct = pad(congruent_correct, max_length),
      congruent_incorrect = pad(congruent_incorrect, max_length),
      incongruent_correct = pad(incongruent_correct, max_length),
      incongruent_incorrect = pad(incongruent_incorrect, max_length)
    )

    write.csv(
      timing_df,
      file = file.path(
        output_dir,
        paste0(participant, "_run", run_number, "_timing.csv")
      ),
      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )


    # ADD TO QC SUMMARY


    qc_summary <- rbind(
      qc_summary,
      data.frame(
        Participant = participant,
        Run = run_number,
        BlankCue = length(blank_cue),
        CenterCue = length(center_cue),
        SpatialCue = length(spatial_cue),
        CongruentCorrect = length(congruent_correct),
        CongruentIncorrect = length(congruent_incorrect),
        IncongruentCorrect = length(incongruent_correct),
        IncongruentIncorrect = length(incongruent_incorrect),
        TotalCorrect = total_correct,
        Flag = flag,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )

  }   # END RUN LOOP

  cat("Finished:", participant, "\n")

}   # END PARTICIPANT LOOP


# WRITE QC SUMMARY


write.csv(
  qc_summary,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "ANT_QC_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("timing file created successfully!\n")
cat("QC summary saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(output_dir, "ANT_QC_summary.csv"), "\n")
cat("=========================================\n")
```
